learning_outcomes.text: Students will be trained to handle the fundamental concepts related to Acoustical Engineering
Students will acquire knowledge to calculate the acoustic insulation of spaces intended for housing and activities
Students will acquire the ability to design and verify the acoustic conditioning of spaces
Students will be able to propose and justify the effect of corrective measures, acoustic screens, and barriers
Students will be able to handle technical instrumentation, sound level meters, noise sources, and sound analyzers
Students will be able to structure an acoustic study based on current legislation

syllabus_topics: Acoustics in Industrial Activities and Environments
assessment_rules: For the final evaluation, students who need it may take a written exam that evaluates 100% of all theoretical and practical aspects of the subject. The theoretical-practical exam will consist of a written test evaluating both theoretical content through brief questions and practical content through problem-solving. A minimum of 4 out of 10 points will be required to pass the exam.
